Gramlot 0.2.1 publishes the JavaScript core on npm and JSR under one name, `@gramlot/gramlot`. The Python package and the runtime behaviour are those of 0.2.0.

## What changes

- npm and JSR: `@gramlot/gramlot` (`npm install @gramlot/gramlot` or `npx jsr add @gramlot/gramlot`). The earlier JSR package `@genro/gramlot` (0.1.0–0.2.0) is archived; the unpublished development name `@gramlot/native-html` is gone.
- Dependencies: `@genrojs/bag` 0.10.1, `@genrojs/builders` 0.4.1 and `@genrojs/tytx` 0.16.1 on npm; the JSR package maps them to `@genro/bag`, `@genro/builders` and `@genro/tytx`.
- Releases: one workflow run on the tag publishes to PyPI, npm and JSR with trusted publishing.

## Upgrading from 0.2.0

- JavaScript imports: replace `@genro/gramlot`, `@jsr/genro__gramlot` or `@gramlot/native-html` with `@gramlot/gramlot` (subpaths `/page`, `/server`, `/host`, `/runtime` are unchanged).
- Python: no change.
